topic: Simon Baron-Cohen, Alan Leslie & Uta Frith (1985) London Sally-Anne Marble Transfer False-Belief Experiment, Age-Four Parietal-Prefrontal Leap, Milton Double Empathy, and Adult Curse of Knowledge
act5_climax_episode: Adults tapping familiar songs on a wooden table guessing fifty percent listener recognition while actual listeners almost never recognize the tune from bare knocks, proving the Curse of Knowledge persists into adulthood.
